note: Chapter 1 keys Neto's cross on 'Neto crosses', Thiago Silva's header clear on 'Thiago Silva clears', the ball dropping to him on 'but only to him', the strike on 'He curls it' and the goal on 'into the top corner'. Chapter 2 keys the touch on 'One touch' and the open body on 'He opens his body'. Chapter 3 keys the apology on 'he raises his hands'. Read 'João Pedro' as zhoo-OWN PEH-droo, 'Fluminense' as floo-mee-NEN-see, 'Fábio' as FAH-bee-oo, 'Thiago' as chee-AH-goo.

chapters.label: The curler, live
chapters.text: The Club World Cup semi-final. Chelsea's new striker, João Pedro, faces Fluminense, his old club. Neto crosses. Thiago Silva clears it, but only to him. He curls it... into the top corner!

chapters.label: Set yourself
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. One touch to set himself. He opens his body towards the far post.

chapters.label: The curl
chapters.text: The ball swerves and dips, past Fábio, into the top corner. No celebration: he raises his hands to say sorry to his boyhood club.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: open your body, and curl the ball so it bends away from the keeper!
